text: function scrapes OWRD Near Real-Time Hydrograph web application (https://apps.wrd.state..us/apps/sw/hydro_near_real_time/). performs initial GET request retrieve ASP.NET form state (__VIEWSTATE etc.) submitting POST request download data TSV format. persistent session handle used preserve cookies across requests. form containing __VIEWSTATE located explicitly (ID first, field content) rather assumed first form page, since OWRD may add unrelated forms (banners, widgets) ahead real one. browser-like User-Agent sent requests, GET/POST sequence retried backoff transient failures.
